_comment: Copy to policy.json. Declares the cross-zone flows that are APPROVED. Everything else is a violation. Without this file every legitimate administration path is reported as a finding, so triage stays manual forever.
_matching: The most specific matching rule wins ('*' is a wildcard). Among equally specific matches, deny beats allow so an ambiguous policy fails closed. An EXPIRED allow rule does not authorise traffic -- it is reported as an expired exception.

rules.justification: Jump-host administration. All privileged access is expected to originate here.
Domain join, authentication and directory lookup.
Normal application access over TLS only.
Guest network is internet-only. Explicit deny so this can never be widened by a broader allow.
IT/OT separation. CISA/NSA AA23-278A calls out that lack of segmentation between IT and OT places OT environments at risk. Traffic must traverse a documented DMZ/conduit.
